dialogue.offer: The outer summoner feeds the circle. Defeat that cultist before the ritual draws more power.
dialogue.active: The outer summoner still anchors the ritual. Break that link, then return to me.
dialogue.turn_in: One anchor is broken. The circle is weaker, but another summoner is taking its place.

dialogue.offer: Silence the next summoner before the broken link can be restored.
dialogue.active: The next summoner must fall. Keep clear of the circle and return when the link is broken.
dialogue.turn_in: Both links are broken. You have bought us time to face what remains in the chamber.
